rationale: The accepted arbitrary-center rotation lemma resolves the qualification currently recorded in d77/rotational-classification-scope. Its consequences strengthen the cardinality-obstruction node to exclude every nontrivial rotational symmetry for 153-point sets, and strengthen d77/154-half-turn-center from a condition on already half-turn-invariant sets to a classification of any rotationally symmetric 154-point set. The rotational-symmetry program summary should be revised to reflect the now-complete classification. The exact-value question and certified interval remain unchanged, so neither root nor the global bound nodes require updates.
